[EN] Shirka's sulking because I won't let her travel alone.

I don't know why she wants to risk her neck. She's a researcher for crying out loud.
[ES] Shirka está enfurruñada porque no la dejo viajar sola.

No sé por qué quiere arriesgar el pellejo. Es una investigadora, por el amor de Dios.
